answer_q: How is AI used in real estate?
answer: Real estate agencies use AI to respond instantly to buyer and tenant enquiries, book inspections and appraisals, qualify leads, follow up past appraisals, handle maintenance requests and draft listing and campaign material. Agents keep the relationships and negotiations, while AI handles the repetitive communication.
body:
Speed wins in real estate

Buyers and vendors contact several agencies at once, often in the evening or on weekends. The agency that replies first, with a useful answer and a booking, usually wins the conversation. Yet agents are at inspections, in negotiations or driving between appointments when enquiries arrive.

AI makes sure every enquiry gets a fast, accurate reply and a clear next step, and that nothing falls through the cracks in your CRM.

Where AI helps real estate agencies most

Enquiry replies and inspection bookings

Portal and website enquiries receive a personal reply within minutes with property details, inspection times and a booking link. Booked buyers are added to your CRM. See CRM automation.

Appraisal follow-up

Past appraisals and warm vendor leads receive regular, personal follow-ups so agents are top of mind when the owner is ready to sell. See AI voice agent.

After-hours calls

An AI receptionist answers calls when the office is closed, captures details and books appraisals or inspections. See AI receptionist.

Property management

Tenant enquiries, maintenance requests and routine questions are triaged and logged, with urgent issues escalated straight away. See custom AI agents.

Listing and campaign admin

AI drafts listing copy, social posts and vendor reports from your notes for agent review. See AI workflow automation.

Human-backed AI employees for real estate agencies

Most real estate agencies don’t want another tool to supervise. Our AI Employees service builds the AI around your agency, then runs it with a dedicated Crenosoft team that learns your services, clients and rules. The AI handles routine work; our reviewers handle anything unusual, around the clock; and decisions that belong to you come to your nominated person with a clear summary. We agree an hours-saved target up front and report against it every month.

Software we connect to

We work with real estate CRMs and property management systems that offer integrations, such as Rex, VaultRE, PropertyMe and similar platforms, plus portal enquiry emails, calendars, SMS and Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.

Real estate rules and consumer protection

Messages about properties must be accurate and must not mislead, so AI-generated listing copy and replies use only the details your agents approve, and price guidance follows your agency’s policies and state underquoting rules. Outbound follow-up respects consent and opt-outs. Victorian agencies can find guidance from Consumer Affairs Victoria.

Across every project we follow the Privacy Act 1988, the OAIC’s guidance on commercially available AI products and our own Responsible AI Policy.

Where agencies lose leads today

Most leads aren’t lost to a better agent; they’re lost to a slower reply. An enquiry arrives on Saturday evening, the agent is at an open home, and by Monday the buyer has booked with someone else. Appraisal leads go cold because follow-up depends on a busy agent remembering to call. Property managers spend hours answering the same tenant questions. AI fixes each of these gaps with fast, consistent communication, while your agents keep the relationships and negotiations that win listings.

Results we measure for agencies

Before we build, we record a baseline of how long the work takes and how often it happens. After launch, your monthly report tracks the numbers that matter to agencies:

  • Average time to first reply on new enquiries
  • Inspections and appraisals booked by the AI
  • Past appraisals followed up and converted to listings
  • After-hours calls answered
  • Tenant and maintenance requests handled

These figures sit alongside hours saved and accuracy, so you can see exactly what the AI is contributing and where our team is still stepping in.

Because every message comes from approved listing details and agency rules, your brand stays consistent across every agent and every channel.

Principals also gain a clear view of response times and follow-up activity across the whole team, without asking agents to log anything extra.

How to get started

  1. Free AI audit: 30 minutes to map your busiest workflows and pick the first opportunity.
  2. Blueprint and fixed quote: what the AI will do, which systems it connects to and the price in AUD.
  3. Build and test: usually two to six weeks, tested on real examples from your agency.
  4. Launch and improve: monthly reports on hours saved, accuracy and improvements.

Not sure where to begin? Start with an AI Readiness Assessment, or see how we work locally on our Melbourne AI agency page.
faqs: Can AI reply to realestate.com.au and Domain enquiries?
Yes. Enquiry emails from property portals can trigger an AI reply with property details, inspection times and a booking link, and the lead is logged in your CRM.
Will AI give price guidance to buyers?
Only the price information your agency approves for each listing, in line with your policies and state rules. Anything else is passed to the agent.
Can AI help with property management?
Yes. AI can triage tenant enquiries and maintenance requests, answer routine questions and escalate urgent issues to your property managers.
How fast can an agency start?
Enquiry replies and after-hours call answering usually go live within two to three weeks.
